## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For a behavior fix, identify the regression test.

## Review

- [ ] I understand the changed code, including any AI-generated suggestions.
- [ ] Tests verify the intended behavior and meaningful failure paths.
- [ ] I reviewed dependency changes and any visual baseline changes.
- [ ] I did not disable checks or update snapshots just to make CI pass.
